headline: Iran to Ration Electricity as Conflict Damages Energy Infrastructure
summary: State media reported Iran will implement rolling power cuts starting November 22 following extensive damage to key energy infrastructure amid ongoing Middle East military hostilities.
why: Iran is a major OPEC oil producer and natural gas holder whose infrastructure stability affects regional power markets and energy transit.

impacts.name: Iran
impacts.why: Power rationing will disrupt Iranian domestic industrial production and economic activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
